user.title: Music Artwork Lighting
user.description: Select one WLED matrix light for this music experience, or leave the matrix empty for theme-light-only mode or artwork and colors for dashboards. Each matrix has its own integration entry and independent settings; use another entry for another display. Choose one initial media player here, then set the full ordered player priority under Configure.

data_description.device_warmup_delay_seconds: Wait this many seconds after any light or matrix powers on or reconnects before sending commands. The delay applies separately to each device; other devices continue working independently.
data_description.source_entities: Order matters: the first eligible playing music source wins. Artwork is resolved for that source, using online search if enabled, before applying the missing-cover behavior. Current source diagnostics explain the selected player.
data_description.source_stabilization: Wait for player metadata to settle before switching sources or artwork. Increase slightly if your player briefly exposes incomplete metadata.
data_description.target_entity: Clear this selection to run without a WLED matrix. Leave theme lights empty too to expose only artwork and color entities for dashboards and automations.
data_description.theme_light_entities: Optional room lights to color from the cover. Select each light in only one entry, and do not include the matrix here.

tuning.title: Lighting and session behavior
tuning.description: Settings are grouped by what they affect. Matrix and room-light settings only appear when that output is selected.

data_description.animated_artwork: Enabled by default. Play animated covers on the matrix and the Artwork image entity. With online search enabled, show the player cover first, then check for an animated alternative in the background. Static results keep the player cover. Turning this off restores the original player cover after an upgrade; otherwise it uses the cached cover's first frame.
data_description.image_fit: Choose crop-to-fill, black bars, blurred fill, dominant cover-color fill, or mirrored artwork edges. Adjustable blur and background brightness apply to the custom blurred, solid-color, and mirrored styles. The fixed soft/medium/strong presets retain their own brightness.
data_description.image_crop_position: Choose which part of the cover stays in view when it must be cropped. This also anchors the zoomed artwork inside fit modes.
data_description.image_zoom: 100% shows the original cover scale. Increase the value to zoom in; crop position controls which part stays visible. This affects the foreground cover as well as crop-to-fill framing.
data_description.image_blur_strength: Used only by the adjustable blurred-background style. 0% keeps the background sharp; larger values soften it more.
data_description.image_background_brightness: Adjusts the filled area behind the cover in custom blur, dominant-color, and mirrored-edge styles. Set 0% for a black background; 100% keeps its natural brightness.
data_description.transition_style: Choose the visual effect used when the album cover changes. Fade is the recommended everyday option; other effects are more noticeable.
data_description.transition_seconds: Controls how long the matrix transition takes. Shorter values feel snappier; longer values feel smoother.
data_description.fade_to_black: Before each new cover, WLED changes the matrix segment from its Image effect to Solid black and then back to Image. Some WLED builds can show a brief visual glitch during this effect change. Turn this off to use a direct native transition between covers.
data_description.black_pause: Time spent at black between covers when fade-to-black is enabled. Set to 0 for no extra pause.
data_description.theme_color_mode: Changes how album-cover colors are distributed across your theme lights. Artwork palette is the general-purpose recommendation.
data_description.theme_light_transition: Sets the time for color fades and fade-to-black. It is ignored for instant changes and device-default timing. Some lights may use their own transition when the device-default mode is selected.
data_description.end_grace_seconds: How long playback must remain stopped, or paused with the grace-period behavior selected, before the end behavior runs. Resume playback to cancel the countdown.
data_description.segment_id: The WLED segment to receive the artwork. Most single-matrix setups use segment 0.
data_description.auto_detect_size: Use dimensions reported by WLED when available. Manual width and height are fallback values when detection is unavailable or disabled.
data_description.pause_behavior: Some Cast players keep the last album visible after casting stops. End after the grace period is recommended for reliable cleanup; choose hold to preserve the scene indefinitely during a pause.
data_description.theme_fade_mode: Choose whether theme lights change instantly, fade directly between album colors, or fade to black in sync with the matrix when its fade-to-black option is enabled. Device default leaves transition timing to each light.
data_description.theme_color_adjustments: Choose whether to lift near-black extracted colors, balance their perceived brightness, apply both, or use the artwork colors as-is.
data_description.auto_power_mode: Power-on behavior applies only to outputs selected above. With both matrix and theme lights selected, choose which output types may turn on automatically. With one output type selected, the choices are power it on or leave it off.
data_description.no_art_behavior: Used before any cover art has appeared in the current session. Wait leaves lights unchanged until music metadata or cover art is available. Choose a fallback scene only if you want supported audio-only sources to affect the room.
data_description.no_art_during_session_behavior: Used only after cover art appeared in the current session. Keep the last scene through brief metadata gaps, use the configured fallback color on room lights with the matrix off, or turn selected outputs off.
data_description.online_artwork_lookup: Search selected services for missing music covers. When Animated artwork is also enabled, show a usable static player cover first, then look for an animated alternative in the background. Keep the original unless a real animation is found. Both searches send title, artist, and album to selected services, even when a static cover is already available. Results are reused for the song; Refresh artwork retries, subject to service cooldowns. Turn off to stop both searches. Video/TV-only sources are not searched.
data_description.lastfm_api_key: Optional. Enter the API key from your Last.fm API account. The shared secret is not used for cover lookups. Last.fm is queried only when selected above. Status shows key and connection errors; its online_artwork_lookup attributes give each service result. The key is stored in integration options and sent to Last.fm for lookups.
data_description.ignored_inputs: Optional. Enter exact source values shown in the media player attributes to skip those inputs. Separate values with commas or new lines. Matching ignores capitalization and punctuation. Example: Product (TV), Product (HDMI1). Leave blank to allow all inputs.
data_description.artwork_provider_1: Try selected services from first to fourth until a missing cover is found. For an animated alternative to a player cover, continue past static results. Choose Disabled to skip a position; repeated services are used once. Disable all four to make no online requests. MusicBrainz / Cover Art Archive and Deezer need no key. Last.fm is skipped without an API key. TheAudioDB can use its limited shared free key.
data_description.artwork_provider_2: Try this service if earlier services have no matching cover or are unavailable. Disabled skips this position.
data_description.artwork_provider_3: Try this service if earlier services have no matching cover or are unavailable. Disabled skips this position.
data_description.artwork_provider_4: Try this service if earlier services have no matching cover or are unavailable. Disabled skips this position.
data_description.theaudiodb_api_key: Leave blank to use TheAudioDB’s shared free key (123), which has limited access and shared request limits. A personal API key uses your account’s access and limits. TheAudioDB is queried only when selected above. The key is stored in integration options, sent only to TheAudioDB, and removed from downloadable diagnostics.
data_description.room_end_behavior: Restore the saved room colors, optionally including saved brightness. A room light that was off before playback is turned off again. Keep leaves music lighting in place; turn off switches all selected room lights off.
data_description.matrix_end_behavior: Choose independently from room lights: restore the pre-playback matrix state, leave the last artwork visible, or switch the matrix off.
